# Get-ZbxQueue

## SYNOPSIS

Gets how many items are overdue on the server, and by how much.

## SYNTAX

### Overview (Default)

```
Get-ZbxQueue [-Server <DnsEndPoint[]>] [-ByProxy] [-Tls <ZabbixTlsMode>] [-PskIdentity <string>] [-Psk <SecureString>] [-Certificate <string>] [-CertificateKey <string>] [-CertificateAuthority <string>] [-CertificateRevocationList <string>] [-ServerIssuer <string>] [-ServerSubject <string>] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [<CommonParameters>]
```

### Details

```
Get-ZbxQueue [-Server <DnsEndPoint[]>] -Details [-Limit <int>] [-Tls <ZabbixTlsMode>] [-PskIdentity <string>] [-Psk <SecureString>] [-Certificate <string>] [-CertificateKey <string>] [-CertificateAuthority <string>] [-CertificateRevocationList <string>] [-ServerIssuer <string>] [-ServerSubject <string>] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

The Get-ZbxQueue cmdlet asks the server's trapper for its queue (queue.get), the items whose values are late: by default an overview of how many items of each item type are 5, 10, 30 seconds and longer overdue; with -ByProxy the same counts per proxy; with -Details the overdue items themselves, most overdue first. It needs a Super admin's connection, whose API token the trapper accepts as the session, and the trapper in -Server or the connection's.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Show the queue by item type

```powershell
Get-ZbxQueue -Server 'zabbix.example:10051'
```

Each row is one item type; the columns count the items overdue by more than 5, 10, 30, 60 and 300 seconds and 10 minutes.

### Example 2: List the most overdue items

```powershell
(Get-ZbxQueue -Server 'zabbix.example:10051' -Details -Limit 10).Items
```

-Details lists the items themselves; -Limit caps the list (100 by default).

## PARAMETERS

### -Server

The server's trapper: host or host:port (port 10051 when omitted; an IPv6 address with a port is bracketed, [::1]:10051). Several are the nodes of one HA cluster, tried in order. The connection's (Connect-ZbxServer -Trapper), else the active HA node's, when omitted.

## INPUTS

None.

## OUTPUTS

- `ZabbixQueueDelays`: One row of the queue overview: how many items of one item type are overdue by more than 5, 10, 30, 60, 300 and 600 seconds.
- `ZabbixQueueDetails`: The queue in detail: the most overdue items first, and how many are overdue in all.
